title.why: Unchanged. The English title is KLRI's government translation of the decree's name ('ENFORCEMENT DECRFEE OF THE FRAMEWORK ACT ON THE DEVELOPMENT OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND THE CREATION OF A FOUNDATION FOR TRUST', typo in KLRI's heading), stored at the KLRI url.

issuing_body.why: Unchanged. President (decree) and competent MSIT division '과학기술정보통신부 (인공지능안전신뢰정책과)' on the law.go.kr page.

official_identifier.why: Which value the stored text supports: both. The first extraction's 'Presidential Decree No. 36053' is the enacting decree: addenda '부 칙 <대통령령 제36053호, 2026. 1. 21.>', KLRI 'Presidential Decree No. 36053, Jan. 21, 2026', and law.go.kr '[시행 2026. 1. 22.] [대통령령 제36053호, 2026. 1. 21., 제정]'. It matches date_published 2026-01-21 and is the number that KR-02 style (enactment number) citations use. The current version is Decree No. 36580 (header), which the extraction puts in date_last_updated and notes. The blind extraction's null drops a number that the text clearly gives; the first extraction is the better value. The old value that also named 'current version No. 36580' was a version label, which AGENTS.md 5.6 excludes from official_identifier, so the shorter value is also the more correct one.

date_in_force.why: 2026-01-22: '제1조(시행일) 이 영은 2026년 1월 22일부터 시행한다. 다만, 별표 1 중 디지털의료기기에 관한 부분은 2026년 1월 24일부터 시행한다.' The 24 Jan carve-out for part of Annex 1 is correctly put in notes.

date_last_updated.why: 2026-08-18: '[시행 2026. 8. 20.] [대통령령 제36580호, 2026. 8. 18., 타법개정]'. This is a consequential amendment (a different decree changing one cross-reference in Art. 2(2)(b)); it counts as last amendment under 5.6. The substantive amendment is No. 36506 of 20 Jul 2026.

status.why: In force: both the enactment and the 20 Aug 2026 version are in force today (14 Oct 2026); no later amendment seen.

legal_force.why: Binding; Art. 1 states it prescribes matters delegated by and necessary to enforce the Act.

english_version.why: kind 'government translation' by KLRI; url https://elaw.klri.re.kr/eng_service/lawViewContent.do?hseq=73696 is a stored source (archive/_runs/2026-10-14-refresh-translation-fixes/KR-03/extra-89755482f2/2026-10-14/official.html, sha256 f66190079ffc...). It translates the enacted text of 21 Jan 2026 only, as the verification note says.

summary.why: All claims found in the Korean text; see summary_claims.

notes.why: Everything checked is supported: addenda Art. 2 repeals 「국가인공지능전략위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정」 and Art. 4 carries the committee over; No. 36506 (promulgated 20 Jul 2026, in force 21 Jul 2026) added Art. 1-2 and Art. 28(1)1 requires the vulnerable groups' characteristics to be reflected in impact assessments; No. 36580 amends Art. 2(2)(b). One incompleteness: Art. 29(1) has four criteria for the domestic-agent duty, and the notes list three. The fourth is operators that have been fined under Art. 43(1)3 of the Act ('법 제43조제1항제3호에 따른 과태료를 부과 받은 사실이 있는 인공지능사업자'). The sentence reads as a complete list; adding the fourth would be safer, but nothing in it is wrong, so no fix is required.

summary_claims.claim: Art. 24: the Art. 32 safety duties apply to systems trained with at least 10^26 floating-point operations, using the most advanced AI technology currently in use, whose risk may broadly and seriously affect life, safety or fundamental rights
summary_claims.locator: Art. 24(1), all three criteria cumulative ('모두 충족'): '1. 학습에 사용된 누적 연산량이 10의 26승 부동소수점연산 이상일 것 2. ...현재 인공지능시스템에 활용되는 인공지능기술 중 최첨단의 인공지능기술을 적용하여 구성ㆍ운영되고 있을 것 3. ...사람의 생명, 신체의 안전 및 기본권에 광범위하고 중대한 영향을 미칠 우려가 있을 것'. My translation: 'cumulative compute used in training is at least 10^26 floating-point operations; built and operated with the most cutting-edge AI technology among that used in AI systems at present; the system's risk may have a broad and serious effect on life, bodily safety and fundamental rights'. The word 'cumulative' is dropped from the summary; no change in meaning.

summary_claims.claim: Art. 23: operators must give prior notice of high-impact or generative AI and may mark generative outputs in human-perceivable or machine-readable form
summary_claims.locator: Art. 23(1) '사전에 고지해야 한다' (must notify in advance) and 23(2) '다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 방법으로 할 수 있다: 1. 사람이 인식할 수 있는 방법 2. 기계가 판독할 수 있는 방법' (may do so by: a way a person can perceive; a machine-readable way). The summary's must/may split is exactly right.

summary_claims.claim: Art. 2 defines the defence, intelligence and police AI excluded from the Act
summary_claims.locator: Art. 2: tasks designated by the Minister of National Defence (1), the Director of the National Intelligence Service (2), the Commissioner General of the National Police Agency (3), 'only' ('만을') for such tasks.

summary_claims.claim: Organises the National AI Strategy Committee and the AI Safety Institute

scope.note: Binding implementing decree of the national AI law; in scope, no note.

note: The decree is checked against the full current Korean text on law.go.kr (browser-rendered, Decree No. 36580) and KLRI's translation of the enacted text. Every quoted field passes the evidence script, and the summary's most specific claims (the Art. 23 notice and marking duties with their must/may wording, and the cumulative three-part Art. 24 threshold) match the Korean. Blind-sample difference official_identifier: the text supports 'Presidential Decree No. 36053' as the identifier of the decree (enactment number, consistent with date_published); the blind null is the weaker value and the old combined value was a version label. Minor: the notes omit the fourth criterion of Art. 29(1). No web search for newer amendments was done beyond the stored law.go.kr page of 14 Oct 2026, which shows 36580 as current.
